extra.reason: Added visibility to CreateSessionRequest/UpdateSessionRequest (now required on both), wired through to domain SetVisibility/NewSession, and removed the standalone-must-be-public restriction so standalone sessions can be public or private.
Removed hardcoded GATEWAY_API_KEY from observability/prometheus.yml; switched to credentials_file backed by a Docker Compose secret, rotated the key in .env

Added a transaction-scoped Postgres advisory lock (lockSessionCapacity) before each capacity check/write in CreateRSVP, UpdateRSVP, and ApproveAttendee, closing the check-then-act race. Verified with a concurrency integration test that fails without the lock and passes with it.

Made NewRSVPManualAttendee check capacity itself for status=Going (downgrading to Pending + emitting AutoPendingEvent when full) instead of relying on a follow-up UpdateRSVP call that was always a no-op since newStatus already equaled the just-constructed status. Verified with unit tests that fail without the fix.

ReconstructActivityGroup was silently dropping its capacity parameter instead of assigning it to the struct, so GetActivityGroupByID always returned nil DefaultCapacity and group capacity was never enforced regardless of concurrency. Fixed by assigning capacity: capacity in the struct literal; verified via a debug test that round-trips a group through create+load.

Added lockGroupCapacity (transaction-scoped Postgres advisory lock, distinct namespace from the session lock) before the capacity check in RequestToJoin and ApproveMember, mirroring the b48 fix for session attendees. Verified with a concurrency integration test (20 attempts of concurrent ApproveMember against a capacity-1 group); also required fixing rekreativko-api-ypt since the capacity check was otherwise unconditionally skipped.

Added forward-geocoding endpoint (GET /api/v1/geocode/forward) to the location service, mirroring reverse-geocode caching/rate-limiting: structured city+country search, free-text search when street is given, Postgres cache table, shared Nominatim rate limiter, new unlabeled cache-hit/miss counters (no cardinality risk), swagger docs regenerated.
CreateRSVP now propagates non-ErrMemberNotFound member lookup errors instead of treating them as not-a-member
Notifications now store the originating event_id with a unique (event_id, recipient_account_id) constraint; Create uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING so NATS redelivery is a no-op

Location service implemented (commit e233b69): reverse+forward geocoding via gateway, Nominatim UA + 1 req/s limiter, Postgres bucket cache, metrics, compose, swagger and README contract. All acceptance criteria verified in code.

Outbox publisher reads batches in one tx with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED (safe for multiple replicas); failures tracked via retry_count/last_error and dead-lettered via failed_at after OUTBOX_MAX_RETRIES. Unit + integration tests added (a301463).

Added DLQ stream (dlq.>) in shared/events/nats_broker.go: messages are dead-lettered with failure headers after max deliveries or on permanent errors (decode failures marked via events.Permanent), retries use NakWithDelay, metric events_dead_lettered_total. Unit + real-NATS integration tests. Follow-up hardening in rekreativko-api-755.
Created in error - mobile team will file their own ticket in their repo based on a plain-text handoff instead.
Added session-level invites (accept/decline) for standalone sessions: SessionInvite aggregate, session_invites table, service, endpoints, cron expiry, tests, docs

Teams foundation: team config on sessions/templates, session_team + attendee team_id, assign/unassign API with per-team limit under advisory lock, slot release on leave/remove, team events, volleyball
SessionTemplateBuilder defaults to a location (schema requires it); Update test passes the existing location instead of nil
Test_config_Load sets the required GATEWAY_API_KEY, GATEWAY_API_KEYS and OUTBOX_SCHEMAS env vars
Teams are created via POST /sessions/{id}/teams after people join (replace unassigns everyone); removed teams from session creation and templates
